notes.title: Surprise New Feature: Boss Rush Mode!
notes.content:
Quick update here, after getting a few requests for it I decided to add a boss rush mode to the game. It was surprisingly easy to make! But here are a few things you should know: 

- I decided to make boss rush mode unlocked from the start, but I recommend you beat the main game first.

- If you start a game in boss rush mode you can leave the game and continue right from where you were.

- If you die in boss rush mode you restart the boss just like in the main game. (It's less of a survival mode and more of a time attack.)

- This probably does not need to be said, but boss rush mode contains no platforming, no story, and no tutorial. Just bosses.

Have fun! :)

notes.title: Version 1.01 patch.
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! I recently made some tweaks to the game, and they are as follows:
[/b]

- Fixed a glitch where your controller would rumble forever when pausing sometimes.

- Fixed the hit boxes on various late-game enemy attacks.

- Minor changes to late-game levels.

- Removed hard mode damage debuff as it was almost universally hated.

- Made Giga Axe damage more consistent and boosted base damage from 10 to 15.
(For reference, a normal attack does 1 damage.)

- Reduced HP on level 6 boss slightly.

- Fixed an issue that caused Axela's damage to be worse or better than it should be sometimes.

- Added the version number to the results screen.

- Fixed a couple minor tiling mistakes.
